propositions: No aggregated lens exists for analyzing 344 closed bugs across close_class distribution, detection channel, age, root cause fan-in, and time-to-close metrics; currently answered by ad-hoc scripts.
close_class dimension must surface pre-convention bugs (circa 214 unclassed bugs) as an explicit MISSING labeled cohort rather than silently merging eras.

Flow dimensions (close_class-by-month, time-to-close) filter on close transition timestamp within CLI range; stock dimensions (age percentiles, detected_by, caused_by fan-in) are point-in-time measures over current store and ignore range.
detected_by field is sparse/absent; dimension must degrade to unavailable without affecting other dimensions.
New bug_trends lens integrates into rebar metrics registry via standard _spec() registration pattern alongside event_metrics and sidecar_metrics.
